name: AI Generation

sources.title: The Largest Directory of Generative AI Tools

requirements: Directory of generative-AI tools only; categories are Audio, Code, Data, Image, Other, Platforms, Popular, Text, Video
The catalog's listed submit URL (/submit) returns 404; the live entry point is the nav's 'Add Listing / Contact Us' at /add/
Site supports user registration/login, but whether listings are self-serve or contact-mediated is unclear
preparation: Tool name, URL, category (Audio/Code/Data/Image/Other/Platforms/Text/Video), and relevant tags
Contact name, email, and a short pitch - the /add/ page renders a Name/Email/Message 'Request Info' contact form
workflow: Open https://www.theaigeneration.com/add/ (the /submit URL in the catalog is dead)
The page loads a contact/request form ('Loading…' placeholder rendered via JS); fill name, email, and a message requesting the tool be listed
Alternatively register an account via the Sign Up modal and look for an in-account add-listing flow
watchFor: Footer advertises 'Forever free' (refers to the newsletter/directory, not confirmed for listings)
Site is a WordPress-style directory; the /add/ page is primarily a contact form, so submission may be manual/email-mediated rather than a structured listing form
No published pricing or review-time information found
countsAsLive: A dedicated listing page under /directory/<tool-slug>/ exists and is reachable from category/tag filters.
unknowns: Whether there is a true self-serve listing form behind account registration
Cost of listing (no pricing page found; 'freemium' per third-party catalogs is unconfirmed)
